five_day_thesis: Spot is net unchanged across the window — $4,186.6 to $4,187.0 (+$0.4) — but the path was a full round trip: $4,202.2 on 10/02, a $4,156.7 low on 10/06, then a +$30.3 recovery into 10/07. The structure never moved with it: max pain pegged at $5,500, put wall $3,500 and call wall $5,500 for all five sessions — zero drift, zero migration anywhere. What did change is vol and positioning: ATM IV compressed 21.66% to 20.45% (-1.21pp), the sharpest leg -0.69pp on 10/07, while call OI added +6,168 contracts against just +1,821 puts, a 3.4:1 upside-skewed build on a flat tape. Windowed GEX collapsed from 203.6 on 10/02 to 67.3 into the 10/06 low, then rebuilt to 182.1 — the gamma cushion thins on every dip and re-forms on every bounce. The regime read is premium decay into frozen structure, not trend: vol bleeding, walls static, upside OI quietly accumulating ahead of a 49-DTE expiry.
